mapper.select: SELECT s.source_project_key AS source_key,p.id,p.tenant_id,p.version,p.project_code,p.project_type,p.company_id,p.company_code,p.company_name,p.lifecycle_status,p.deleted FROM proj_legacy_detail_source s JOIN proj_project p ON p.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND p.id=s.project_id WHERE s.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND s.source_system='DPPMS' AND s.source_project_key IN #{key}AND 1=0 FOR UPDATE

SELECT CAST(p.id AS CHAR) AS source_key,p.id,p.tenant_id,p.version,p.project_code,p.project_type,p.company_id,p.company_code,p.company_name,p.lifecycle_status,p.deleted FROM proj_project p WHERE p.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND p.id IN #{id}AND 1=0 ORDER BY p.id FOR UPDATE
